steps.text: Peel the potatoes and onion and cut them into thin slices.
Fry them in a pan with oil over medium heat.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Drain the potatoes and mix them with the egg.
Cook the omelette for 2 minutes on each side.
Boil the rice for 12 minutes and drain it.
Cut the pepper and carrot into strips.
Stir-fry the vegetables with a little oil.
Add the rice and the beaten egg. Stir.
Add a splash of soy sauce and serve.
Cut the chicken and pepper into small pieces.
Cook the chicken in the pan.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, pepper and cheese.
Toast them for 2 minutes on each side.
Cut them into triangles and you are done.
Chop the zucchini, onion and potato.
Boil everything in salted water.
Blend it with a little of the cooking water.
Serve with grated cheese on top.
Boil the pasta for the time on the packet.
Brown the garlic and add the tomatoes.
Mix the tuna into the sauce.
Combine the pasta with the sauce and serve.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a little oil.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them in.
Add the cheese, fold the omelette and cook it through.
Put the rice on to boil for 12 minutes.
Cut the chicken into strips and add salt.
Brown the garlic and chicken in the pan.
Add the lemon juice and let it reduce.
Serve the chicken on top of the rice.
Fry the onion and pepper gently.
Add the tomatoes and cumin. Let it simmer.
Make two holes and crack an egg into each one.
Cover the pan until the eggs are set.

credit.author: Johan Bichel Lindegaard from Copenhagen, Denmark

steps.text: Fry the onion gently.
Add the curry powder, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Add the chickpeas and let it simmer.
Serve with rice.
Turn the oven on to 200 °C.
Cut the vegetables and put them on the tray with oil.
Place the salmon on top with lemon slices.
Bake until the salmon is cooked.
Fry the finely chopped onion.
Add the mushrooms and rice. Stir for 2 minutes.
Add the hot stock little by little, stirring all the time.
Turn off the heat, add the cheese and let it rest.

name: Avocado toast with a fried egg

steps.text: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with a fork, a few drops of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Fry the egg in a little oil until the white is set.
Spread the avocado on the toast, put the egg on top and add pepper.
Mix the oats, milk and yogurt in a jar or a bowl.
Slice half the banana and stir it in with a pinch of cinnamon.
Close the jar and leave it in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, add the rest of the banana and a little honey.
Mash the banana in a bowl.
Add the eggs, oats and a pinch of cinnamon and mix well.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat.
Pour in small spoonfuls of batter and cook until bubbles appear, then flip.
Serve with a little honey on top.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into chunks.
Slice a quarter of the onion very thin.
Put everything in a bowl with the feta on top.
Add oil, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water.
Cut the tomato into small pieces.
Drain the pasta, keeping a splash of the water.
Mix the pasta with the pesto, the tomato and the splash of water. Add the cheese on top.
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Put the ham and cheese between the slices, butter side out.
Cook in a pan over medium heat until golden, then flip.
Cook the other side until the cheese melts.

credit.author: Steven Depolo from Grand Rapids, MI, USA

steps.text: Cook the rice in salted boiling water.
Rinse the rice under cold water and drain it well.
Cut the tomato into small cubes and drain the tuna and sweetcorn.
Mix everything with a little oil. It keeps two days in the fridge.
Chop the onion, carrot and garlic into small pieces.
Fry them in a pot with a little oil.
Add the lentils, tomato, stock and a pinch of cumin.
Simmer with the lid on until the lentils are soft.
Drain and rinse the beans, then mash them a little with a fork and a pinch of cumin.
Spread the beans over one tortilla, add the sweetcorn and cheese and cover with the other.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat, then flip.
Cook the other side until the cheese melts.
Cut into quarters.

name: Yogurt bowl with berries and oats

steps.text: Put the yogurt in a bowl.
Add the berries. If they are frozen, leave them 10 minutes to thaw.
Sprinkle the oats on top and add a little honey.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Cut the cucumber and tomato into small cubes.
Mix everything in a bowl.
Dress with lemon juice, oil, a pinch of cumin and salt.

name: Soy noodles with broccoli and carrot

steps.text: Cook the noodles following the packet, then drain them.
Cut the broccoli into small pieces and the carrot into thin strips.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic in a hot pan with a little oil.
Add the noodles and a splash of soy sauce and mix for one minute.
Cut the zucchini and pepper into cubes.
Fry them in a pan with oil and a pinch of cumin.
Heat the stock until it boils and pour it over the couscous.
Cover the couscous and wait.
Fluff it with a fork and mix in the vegetables and chickpeas.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Prick the sweet potato a few times with a fork.
Bake it until soft inside.
Warm the beans and sweetcorn with a pinch of paprika and salt.
Cut the potato open, fill it with the beans and add the yogurt on top.
Beat the egg with the milk and a pinch of cinnamon in a wide plate.
Soak each slice of bread on both sides.
Cook in a pan with a little butter until golden, then flip.
Cook the other side.
Sprinkle a little sugar on top.
Chop the onion and pepper.
Fry them in a pot with a little oil until soft.
Add the meat and cook until it is brown all over.
Add the tomato, the beans, cumin and paprika.
Simmer, stirring from time to time. Cook the rice in the meantime.
Serve the chili over the rice.
Chop the onion, carrot and garlic very small.
Fry them in a pan with oil until soft.
Add the meat and cook until brown.
Add the tomato and oregano and simmer.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water while the sauce simmers.
Drain the pasta and serve it with the sauce.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water.
Beat the eggs with the cheese and plenty of black pepper.
Fry the bacon in a pan without oil until crispy.
Take the pan off the heat. Add the drained pasta and a splash of its water.
Pour in the egg mix and stir fast so it turns creamy and does not scramble.
Start cooking the rice.
Cut the chicken into strips and the vegetables into small pieces.
Cook the chicken in a very hot pan with a little oil.
Add the vegetables, garlic and some grated ginger.
Add a splash of soy sauce, mix and serve with the rice.
Press the tofu with kitchen paper to dry it and cut it into cubes.
Fry the tofu in a pan with oil, turning it until crispy.
Cook the noodles and the broccoli together in boiling water.
Mix the peanut butter with soy sauce and two spoons of hot water.
Grate the carrot. Mix the noodles, broccoli, carrot and sauce, and put the tofu on top.
Fry the sliced garlic in oil until golden.
Add the paprika and cumin and stir for a few seconds so they do not burn.
Add the tomato and the drained chickpeas and simmer.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.

name: Sweet potato and black bean tacos

steps.text: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into small cubes.
Fry it in a pan with oil, paprika and cumin until soft.
Add the drained beans and warm them up.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice.
Warm the tortillas and fill them with the potato, beans and avocado.
Cut the chicken, pepper and onion into thin strips.
Mix the chicken with paprika, cumin and a little oil.
Cook the chicken in a very hot pan.
Add the pepper and onion and cook until soft.
Warm the tortillas and fill them.
Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Slice the chorizo.
Fry them in a pot with a little oil.
Peel the potatoes and break them into chunks with the knife, so they release starch.
Add the potatoes, a pinch of paprika and the stock.
Simmer until the potatoes are soft.
Cook the rice in salted boiling water.
Slice two cloves of garlic.
Fry the garlic in oil over low heat until it starts to turn golden.
Turn up the heat, add the shrimp and paprika and cook until pink.
Add a squeeze of lemon and serve over the rice.
Rinse the lentils. Chop the onion, garlic and a piece of ginger.
Fry them in a pot with a little oil.
Add the curry powder and stir for a few seconds.
Add the lentils, coconut milk and 300 ml of water and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice in the meantime and serve together.
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the pasta and add the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the flour and stir for one minute.
Add the milk little by little, stirring all the time, until it thickens.
Mix in half the cheese, then the drained pasta and broccoli.
Put it in a dish, add the rest of the cheese on top and bake.
Cut all the vegetables into cubes of about the same size.
Fry the onion, garlic and pepper in a pot with oil.
Add the eggplant and zucchini and cook, stirring.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and salt. Cover and simmer.
It tastes even better the next day, so it is a good one to cook for two meals.

name: Soy and honey salmon with rice

steps.text: Start cooking the rice.
Mix two spoons of soy sauce with one of honey and some grated garlic.
Cook the salmon skin side down in a pan with a little oil.
Flip it, pour in the sauce and let it bubble until sticky.
Steam or boil the broccoli.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the broccoli and the sauce.
Mix the meat with the egg, oats, a pinch of salt and half the garlic, chopped.
Shape small balls with wet hands.
Brown them in a pan with oil, turning them.
Take them out. Fry the chopped onion and the rest of the garlic in the same pan.
Add the tomato, put the meatballs back in and simmer with the lid on.
Cut the chicken into pieces and the pepper into strips. Grate the tomato.
Brown the chicken in a wide pan with oil, then add the pepper.
Add the garlic, the tomato and the paprika and cook.
Add the rice and stir for one minute so every grain gets coated.
Pour in the hot stock and the peas. Do not stir from now on.
Take it off the heat, cover it with a clean cloth and let it rest.
Mix the flour, a pinch of yeast, a pinch of salt, a spoon of oil and 90 ml of warm water.
Knead until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Cover the bowl and let the dough rise somewhere warm.
Heat the oven as high as it goes. Stretch the dough thin on a tray with a little oil.
Spread the tomato, add the torn mozzarella and the oregano.
Bake until the edges are golden.

name: Potato gnocchi with butter and cheese

steps.text: Boil the potatoes with the skin on until soft.
Peel them while hot and mash them until there are no lumps.
Add the egg, a pinch of salt and the flour little by little until the dough stops sticking.
Roll it into long sausages and cut them into small pieces.
Cook them in salted boiling water. They are ready when they float.
Toss them in a pan with melted butter and add the cheese.
Fry the chopped onion in oil, add the meat and cook until brown.
Add the tomato and simmer to make the meat sauce.
For the white sauce, melt the butter, add the flour, then the milk little by little, stirring until thick.
Heat the oven to 190 °C.
In a small dish, make layers: meat sauce, sheets, white sauce. Repeat and finish with white sauce and cheese.
Bake until the top is golden.
Cut the chicken into cubes and mix it with the yogurt, curry powder, garlic and grated ginger.
Leave it to marinate in the fridge.
Brown the chicken in a very hot pan with a little oil.
Add the tomato and coconut milk and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice while the sauce simmers and serve together.

credit.author: William Andrus from Northglenn, CO, USA

steps.text: Cook the rice until it is almost done.
Heat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the tops off the peppers and take out the seeds.
Fry the chopped onion and mushrooms in oil.
Mix the rice with the mushrooms, the tomato and half the cheese.
Fill the peppers, add the rest of the cheese on top and put the lids back on.
Bake until the peppers are soft.
Dry the chickpeas very well with kitchen paper.
Blend or mash them with a quarter of the onion, the garlic, cumin, salt and the flour.
Shape small flat balls and leave them in the fridge so they hold together.
Fry them in a pan with a good layer of oil, turning them until crispy.
Cut the cucumber and tomato and dress them with lemon.
Fill the tortillas with the falafel and the salad.

name: Salmon with lemon butter and mashed potatoes

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces and boil them until soft.
Drain them and mash them with half the butter, the warm milk and salt.
Cook the salmon skin side down in a hot pan until the skin is crispy.
Flip it and cook the other side.
Take out the salmon. Melt the rest of the butter in the pan with a little garlic and lemon juice.
Serve the salmon on the mash with the lemon butter on top.
Boil the egg for a soft yolk, then put it in cold water and peel it.
Heat the stock with sliced garlic, a piece of ginger and a splash of soy sauce.
Poach the whole chicken breast in the stock.
Take the chicken out and shred it with two forks.
Add the sliced carrot and the noodles to the stock.
Put the spinach in a bowl, pour the soup over and add the chicken and the egg cut in half.
